title: Police Arrest Employee After Trying To Steal $60,000 Car From His Job
description:
#cops #police #arrest

On January 24th, 2024. Officers were called to a car rental company in regards to an employee trying to drive off with a company vehicle after clocking off from work. The man tried to give a story that wasn’t adding to the officers and everyone knew he was lying. When officers ran his name on the system, a warrant out of San Antonio showed up and he was arrested. During the search of his person, a wallet was found that did not belong to him. It contained credit cards and ids.  This is the body-cam footage of the events that followed.
